$comment: TypeScript 7 does not auto-discover node_modules/@types; this list is the
same set TypeScript 5.9 auto-discovered for this program. See the root
tsconfig.json for the full rationale and the maintenance rule.
`extends` gives this program the root's `paths`, so `@datazen/*` imports
resolve. This program was already green, but it shares the same contract
as its four sibling packages and should not be the one that breaks when a
`vite/client` supplies the ambient Vite contract (import.meta.env and the
`*.svg` / `*.svg?url` module declarations). This program does not reach
app code today, so it does not need the contract yet; it carries it
because the four packages that do need it are its siblings, and a package
that starts importing an .svg next month must not suddenly break.
The module-layers guard test plants a probe in this package's src to
prove the transport-agnostic rule is armed. Without the exclude,
`tsc -p packages/backend-client` compiles that probe — whose body
contains a Tauri import on purpose, so it cannot type-check here — and
